page_title: BRE 2-4 NEW | Brentford v Newcastle 19/05/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+5' Neal Maupay (Brentford) commits a nasty foul by bringing down his opponent.
90+5' Nick Pope (Newcastle Utd) sees a yellow card. He should be more careful because one more challenge like that could result in a red card.
90+3' One of the players from Brentford times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
90+2' Eddie Howe has decided to substitute Fabian Schar and he is replaced by Paul Dummett (Newcastle Utd).
90' 7 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
86' Brentford take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
84' Substitution. Yegor Yarmolyuk (Brentford) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Yoane Wissa walks off.
81' Eddie Howe has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Callum Wilson (Newcastle Utd) replacing Alexander Isak.
81' Substitution. Joelinton walks off the pitch and Kieran Trippier (Newcastle Utd) comes on as a substitute.
77' Alexander Isak (Newcastle Utd) takes the resulting free kick from the edge of the box, but his low effort is straight at Mark Flekken.
77' 2 - 4 Goal 2:4! Bruno Guimaraes (Newcastle Utd) taps home from close range after the rebound fell kindly into his path.
76' Newcastle are awarded a free kick on the edge of the box.
75' Bryan Mbeumo (Brentford) manages to dispossess his opponent of the ball, but he commits a foul in the process and the referee blows his whistle.
74' Here's the change. Sergio Reguilon leaves the pitch and Neal Maupay (Brentford) comes on as a substitute.
74' Thomas Frank decides to make a substitution. Vitaly Janelt will be replaced by Kevin Schade (Brentford).

70' 2 - 3 Goal! Yoane Wissa (Brentford) weaves his way past opponents, and he unleashes a magnificent effort from the edge of the box into the bottom right corner. Nick Pope had no chance of reaching it. The score is 2:3.
68' Substitution. Miguel Almiron (Newcastle Utd) has come on for Jacob Murphy.
68' The referee signals a substitution. Elliot Anderson (Newcastle Utd) is brought on as a substitute for Harvey Barnes.
66' Emil Krafth (Newcastle Utd) shouldn't be surprised it's a yellow from the ref, who cooled the situation down well.
66' The current number of shots on target for both teams is 7:10.
64' Here is a change. Mathias Jensen is going off and Thomas Frank gives the last tactical orders to Mikkel Damsgaard (Brentford).
63' Substitution. Mads Roerslev Rasmussen will be replaced by Saman Ghoddos (Brentford).

62' Ivan Toney (Brentford) attempts to convert a lofted cross as he jumps high and heads the ball to the bottom left corner. Nick Pope shows his brilliant reflexes and pulls off a glorious save to stop the ball from hitting the net.
62' A poorly taken free kick by Fabian Schar (Newcastle Utd)! He sends a shot from the edge of the box into the defensive wall.
62' A free kick on the edge of the box for Newcastle. Let's see if they'll manage to convert it into a goal.
61' An opponent rises to his feet after being downed by Christian Norgaard (Brentford). Simon Hooper saw the sliding tackle and blows for a foul.
58' Dan Burn (Newcastle Utd) commits a foul after unfairly pressing his opponent during an attacking move.
53' Simon Hooper shows a yellow card to Dan Burn (Newcastle Utd) for his blatant foul.
51' The referee is firm and issues Yoane Wissa (Brentford) a deserved yellow card.
48' 1 - 3 Goal! Yoane Wissa plays a simple square pass into the feet of Vitaly Janelt (Brentford) in the box, who composes himself and lashes the ball into the bottom left corner. 1:3.
48' The ball goes behind for a corner. Brentford will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+6' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45+5' What was Mathias Jensen (Brentford) thinking? He will not get away with that. The referee shows him a yellow card.
45+3' Yoane Wissa (Brentford) misses a good chance to score. A perfect cross into the box finds Yoane Wissa (Brentford) who rises for a header, but he sends the ball well over the bar.
45+1' Alexander Isak (Newcastle Utd) strikes the ball towards goal from the middle of the penalty area, but his shot goes straight into the gloves of the goalkeeper.
45' There will be a minimum of 5 min. of added time.
44' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Ivan Toney (Brentford) was quite harsh and Simon Hooper didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.

38' 0 - 3 GOAL! Superb work from Bruno Guimaraes, who plays a vital role in the build-up. He squares it to Alexander Isak (Newcastle Utd), who beats Mark Flekken with a brilliant shot into the bottom left corner. 0:3.

36' 0 - 2 It's a goal! Alexander Isak plays a lovely pass into the box and finds Jacob Murphy (Newcastle Utd). He tries his luck from close range and coolly strikes the ball into the back of the net. 0:2.
32' The Brentford players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
28' Joelinton (Newcastle Utd) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card without any hesitation from the referee.
26' Sean Longstaff (Newcastle Utd) has a goal ruled out for offside!

21' 0 - 1 Goal! Bruno Guimaraes plays a neat lofted pass into the box for Harvey Barnes (Newcastle Utd), who beats the defender in the air and plants a header into the left side of the goal from close range. 0:1.

18' Bruno Guimaraes (Newcastle Utd) commits a foul on his opponent and it looks like it should be the other way around at first glance, but the referee makes the right decision in awarding a free kick to the other team.
14' Bruno Guimaraes (Newcastle Utd) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Simon Hooper blows his whistle for a foul.
11' Simon Hooper blows his whistle. Christian Norgaard (Brentford) commits a foul after dangerous play. Free kick. Newcastle will probably just try to cross the ball in from here.
9' Ivan Toney (Brentford) misses a big opportunity after striking the ball towards the middle of the goal and the goalkeeper makes an easy save.
6' Brentford have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
5' The goal by Brentford is DISALLOWED on the advice of the video assistant referee due to an offside.
5' Houston, we have a problem! The referee has indicated that there will be a VAR review of the goal to look at a possible offside. The Brentford players aren’t happy.
2' Goal! Ivan Toney (Brentford) finishes from close range with an easy finish and he makes it 0:0. He was ably assisted there by Bryan Mbeumo.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
Newcastle will kick-off.
Today's referee will be Simon Hooper.
Show lineups Before the start of the game, you can see the starting lineups for today's clash.
